severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — INTERACTIVE INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: PHANTOM-DEMO FRONT INUNDATES GAMING REGIONS AS THOUSANDS OF AI-ASSEMBLED GAME DEMOS FLOOD STOREFRONT SHOWCASES WITH POLISHED TRAILERS, UNPLAYABLE BUILDS, AND STUDIOS THAT HAVE NEVER SHIPPED, STAFFED, OR EXISTED
advisory: A broad, slow-moving system of placeholder game demos has settled over interactive regions, raising storefront demo density to levels not previously recorded. Residents are advised that a confident trailer, a wishlist button, and a 'coming soon' banner are not, by themselves, evidence of a game. The Service reminds the public that a demo which crashes on the main menu is still technically interactive, in the way that a locked door is technically a door.

regional_outlook.conditions: Thick demo haze through the afternoon, with visibility reduced by near-identical survival-crafting titles. Expect roughly nine storefronts showing the same inventory grid photographed from the same impossible angle.

Severe overcrowding as an estimated eight-thousand-title showcase saturates to capacity. Human-made entries remain submerged beneath a thick layer of procedurally generated placeholder builds; dredging advised.
Gusty trailer activity pushing 'gameplay' footage that was never rendered in any playable engine. Residents report wishlisting games that do not run.
Scattered announcements of 'solo studios' shipping forty titles a quarter. Pressure dropping on the phrase 'AI-native game development.'
Rising tide of launch-day newsletters for products still in a pre-playable state. Unsubscribe links functional; games not confirmed to be.

specimen.status: Overabundant and spreading; dominant in showcase season.
specimen.habitat: Storefront festivals, wishlist pages, and the exact top of the 'new and trending' row where it blocks the sun from living games below.
specimen.field_marks: A gorgeous key-art banner mated to a build that opens, stutters, and closes. Watch for a 'Start Game' button that leads only to a second 'Start Game' button, and credits listing one team member repeated under eleven invented roles.
specimen.call: Add to Wishlist! Demo available now — full release coming Q-soon™ — your journey begins the moment we finish making it
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuine early-access indie demo, which is also unfinished. Tell them apart by the patch notes: a real demo apologizes for a specific bug; a Phantom Demo apologizes for nothing because no human has yet played it.car

spotter_tip: Before wishlisting, open the demo and walk your character into a wall. A real game stops you. A Phantom Demo lets you walk through the wall, out of the level, and into the grey void where its budget should have been.
tomorrow: Demo haze lingers overnight, thinning slightly as storefront curation teams begin manual dredging; residual placeholder fog in low-moderation basins.

confirmed_sighting.report: Coverage reports that Valve's Steam Next Fest was overwhelmed by a wave of low-effort AI-generated game demos across its roughly 8,000-title lineup, diluting the showcase and crowding out human-made games. The Service classifies this as a textbook phantom-demo inundation event.
